learning_outcomes.text: The student lays a solid foundation for solving electrical networks.
Operation of basic components: sources, resistors, capacitors, coils.
The student analyzes and designs linear networks.
The student lays a solid foundation in networks with semiconductor components: transistors and simple OPAMP.
Structure and operation of transistors: BJT and FET.
The student analyzes and designs circuits containing transistors.
The student builds, measures, and designs the above circuits with semiconductors.
The student practices solving and analyzing networks and circuits with semiconductor components (transistors and opamps).
The student learns to build and measure the above circuits.
The students learn to make circuits error-free.
The student should be able to explain the operation of simple circuits with basic components as well as to dimension the components in such circuits.

syllabus_topics: Construction and soldering exercise print kit1

assessment_methods.method: Practical examination during the last lab session (Lab)

assessment_rules: The total score is on a scale of 1-20. The theory component (YT5773) and the lab component (YT5774) are both graded on a 1-20 scale. For the first examination opportunity, the theory is a 100% oral exam with written preparation in January, and the lab is a practical exam during the last lab session. In case of a successful partial result, a transfer is possible for the theory and lab components within the academic year. The second examination opportunity (resit) in August for theory is a 100% oral exam with written preparation, and for the lab is a practical exam involving individual circuit building and measurement.
